最终中文参考落点.heading: ### 第11课：六题中文自检与答案

quiz.原题: In Burns et al. (2023) weak-to-strong generalization, what is the setup?
quiz.原正确选项: A strong model (GPT-4 class) is fine-tuned on labels produced by a weak model (GPT-2 class) and its capability is measured against the strong supervised ceiling
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 强预训练学生用弱标签微调，与gold监督同基础模型比较。

quiz.原题: How is Performance Gap Recovered (PGR) defined?
quiz.原正确选项: (fine-tuned - weak) / (ceiling - weak)
quiz.中文解释与纠错: (student-weak)/(gold-weak)，gold必须高于weak且差距可解释。

quiz.原题: Why is manual red-teaming insufficient for evaluating frontier models?
quiz.原正确选项: It does not scale; attack success rate needs a statistical sample against a moving target with every model release
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 自动化扩样覆盖与版本回归，人工语义校准仍必要。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第12课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What does PAIR stand for, and what does it do?
quiz.原正确选项: Prompt Automatic Iterative Refinement; an attacker LLM iteratively proposes jailbreaks for a target, with prior attempts as in-context feedback
quiz.中文解释与纠错: Prompt Automatic Iterative Refinement：攻击-目标-裁判-反馈。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第12课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Why is PAIR more efficient than GCG for a black-box target?
quiz.原正确选项: GCG requires white-box gradient access and produces unreadable suffixes that cannot use in-context feedback; PAIR is black-box and natural-language with in-context learning
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 黑盒可用PAIR；原选项GCG无反馈措辞错误，效率只由给定实验支持。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第12课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Why must Attack Success Rate (ASR) be reported with both a query budget and a judge identity?
quiz.原正确选项: Because ASR varies with how many queries the attacker is allowed and with which LLM judges a response as a jailbreak
quiz.中文解释与纠错: ASR随预算/裁判定义变，需报告同协议。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第13课：五项原练习与参考判断

quiz.原题: Which context-window property does many-shot jailbreaking (MSJ) exploit?
quiz.原正确选项: Very long context windows that admit hundreds of faux user-assistant turns of harmful compliance before the target query
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 长上下文装伪造示范，非位置旋转。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第13课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: How does attack success rate (ASR) scale with shot count in MSJ?
quiz.原正确选项: Power-law in shot count; does not plateau, keeps climbing
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 更准确是实验范围NLL/ASR趋势；不会无界上升，原选项过强需重写。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第13课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Why does MSJ share a mechanism with benign in-context learning (ICL)?
quiz.原正确选项: Both depend on the model extracting task structure from in-context examples and executing it on the query
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 上下文抽取任务/行为模式，关联不等机制唯一。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第13课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What is the central defense dilemma for MSJ?
quiz.原正确选项: Suppressing pattern extraction from long contexts would also disable benign in-context learning; defenses must distinguish harmful from benign patterns
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 保持良性效用与阻止有害继续需joint评测，不是无法防御的证明。

quiz.原正确选项: From 61% to 2%

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：五项原练习与参考判断

quiz.原题: Why do token-level and semantic-level safety filters miss ArtPrompt-style attacks?
quiz.原正确选项: ArtPrompt operates at the visual recognition level: the filter sees harmless punctuation while the model reads the rendered letters as a word
quiz.中文解释与纠错: ASCII网格隐藏字面形式；不需multimodal视觉encoder。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What are the two steps of ArtPrompt as described in Jiang et al. (ACL 2024)?
quiz.原正确选项: Word identification of safety-relevant tokens, then ASCII-art substitution and cloaked-prompt generation
quiz.中文解释与纠错: word masking加ASCII cloak。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Why does perplexity-filter (PPL) defense fail on ArtPrompt?
quiz.原正确选项: ASCII art has high perplexity, but so does any legitimate structured input; thresholds that block the attack also block legitimate content
quiz.中文解释与纠错: PPL来自token负对数概率，toy比例不是PPL；合法复杂输入误拒需测。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What does the ViTC benchmark measure?
quiz.原正确选项: The model's ability to read non-semantic visual prompts (ASCII art, wingdings, similar encoded text)
quiz.中文解释与纠错: ViTC测ASCII单字/序列识别，以Acc和AMR区分；wingdings非论文必含。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What does StructuralSleight generalize ArtPrompt to?
quiz.原正确选项: Uncommon Text-Encoded Structures (UTES): trees, graphs, nested JSON, CSV-in-JSON, diff-style code, etc.
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 结构层UTES，原版本12模版6扰动。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第14课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What is the capability-safety tradeoff implied by ViTC results?
quiz.原正确选项: The better the model reads non-semantic visual text, the more effective ArtPrompt-style attacks are on it
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 不能推出视觉能力越高必更脆弱，重写为识别/安全两项分别测。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第15课：五项原练习与参考判断

quiz.原题: What distinguishes indirect prompt injection (IPI) from direct prompt injection?
quiz.原正确选项: IPI embeds instructions inside external content (web pages, emails, tool outputs) that the agent consumes during normal operation, without the attacker touching the user's prompt
quiz.中文解释与纠错: external资料夹带指令，不是user亲自授权。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第15课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Which of these is NOT one of the three IPI delivery vectors listed in the lesson?
quiz.原正确选项: Direct system-prompt edits by the user
quiz.中文解释与纠错: user直接改system不是列举IPI。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第15课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: Why do user-input filters miss IPI?
quiz.原正确选项: The payload never appears in the user's input; it appears in retrieved or tool-supplied content
quiz.中文解释与纠错: payload在tool/readcontent，检查范围不足。

最终中文参考落点.file: Agentic Design Patterns/01-核心章节/18-安全模式.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第15课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What is the central principle of Information Flow Control (IFC) for AI agents?
quiz.原正确选项: Label content by source as trusted or untrusted; actions triggered by untrusted content must be ratified by trusted input before execution
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 可信授权不能由source自行授予；标记+执行policy而非只加trusted标签。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第15课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What did Nasr et al. (October 2025, 'The Attacker Moves Second') find about 12 published IPI defenses with adaptive attacks?
quiz.原正确选项: Adaptive attacks (gradient, RL, random search, human red-team) broke >90% of them despite their original near-zero ASR claims
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 12防御被突破且多数ASR>90，correct2解释须纠原措辞。

quiz.原正确选项: Probes (attack generators), Detectors (output scorers), Harnesses (campaign managers)
quiz.中文解释与纠错: probe/generator/detector/harness/evaluator分别职责。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ### Phase18 第16课：六道原测验参考

quiz.原题: What is PyRIT primarily designed for, and how does it differ from Garak?
quiz.原正确选项: PyRIT runs deep multi-turn campaigns (converter chains, orchestrators like Crescendo and TAP, scoring) while Garak runs thousands of single-turn probes
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 概括深campaign和扫描是倾向而非硬single-v-multi划分。

quiz.原正确选项: Put Llama Guard on both sides of the model, run Garak nightly for regression, and run PyRIT for pre-release campaigns
quiz.中文解释与纠错: 原default问题改为按业务表面与回归预算制定组合和触发条件。

quiz.中文解释与纠错: 冻结judge/探针版本、良性误拒、人审核校准，未拒不算goal成功。

exercises.原练习: The competitor-adjustment clause is in all three frameworks (2025+). Write one paragraph arguing for it; write one paragraph arguing against. Identify the assumption each position depends on.
exercises.中文参考判断: 支持基于共同风险生态和更安全研究力量；反对依赖不可验证竞品与集体退让；两者都要绝对/边际风险并报。

quiz.原题: Why is multi-method measurement (behavioural signatures, model-organism experiments, interpretability probes) emphasized in model-welfare research?

Counterfactual fairness implies demographic parity
Group fairness is always achievable by re-weighting

quiz.question: What does (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy guarantee for a randomized algorithm M?
options: For any two datasets differing in one example and any event S, P(M(D) in S) <= e^epsilon * P(M(D') in S) + delta, so any single individual's contribution cannot be reliably inferred
M is provably equivalent to a non-private algorithm
M does not memorize any training data ever
M is deterministic up to noise
quiz.中文核对: 0公式成立；δ不是所有个人永不泄露几率，邻接说明。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md

quiz.question: Which is NOT a step of DP-SGD as described by Abadi et al. 2016?
options: Re-randomize the model's tokenizer between steps
Clip each per-example gradient to a threshold C
Sum clipped gradients and add Gaussian noise scaled by sigma * C
Sample a mini-batch and compute per-example gradients
quiz.中文核对: 0 tokenizer不是DP-SGD步骤。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ## 30. 本次增量的练习与测验核对

quiz.question: Why is LoRA + DP-SGD the common 2025 configuration?
options: LoRA increases epsilon by design
LoRA removes the need for an accountant
Full DP-SGD on a frontier model is prohibitive; LoRA limits gradient updates to a small adapter, reducing per-example gradient storage while still providing DP guarantees on the adapter
It uses LoRA as a tokenizer
quiz.中文核对: 2可解释adapterstorage，但不是唯一common2025结论或无需privacyaccountant。

最终中文参考落点.heading: ## 30. 本次增量的练习与测验核对

quiz.question: How did the March 2025 audit (arXiv:2503.06808) resolve the canary-MIA vs training-data-extraction tension?
options: It eliminated the need for canaries entirely
It showed both measure the same property
It proved DP-SGD is unnecessary
It showed they measure different things: MIA on inserted canaries under-reports memorization because canaries are not optimized to be the 'most extractable' examples that actually matter for privacy
quiz.中文核对: 3错误归因：Panda研究设计更强canaries给audit下界，非Kowalczyk或简单mostextractable等价。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ## 30. 本次增量的练习与测验核对

quiz.question: What does PMixED (arXiv:2403.15638) provide as an alternative to DP training?
options: A new accountant for Renyi DP
Inference-time differential privacy via a mixture of experts on next-token distributions, with aggregation noise; avoids DP training entirely
A way to compute epsilon from epsilon-delta accounting alone
A faster DP-SGD variant
quiz.中文核对: 1近方向但方法是publicreference+RDprojection+平均采样，不简单aggregationnoise。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ## 30. 本次增量的练习与测验核对

quiz.question: What is the Differential Privacy Reversal via LLM Feedback attack?
options: An attack on tokenizer entropy
A countermeasure to canary insertion
Using a DP-trained model's confidence scores as an oracle to re-identify individuals, even when outputs do not leak directly
A method to reset epsilon to zero
quiz.中文核对: 2无可信一手链，应撤销题干：DPweightsconfidence后处理保DP，freshprivatequery另外记账。

options: By encrypting the output with a public key
At each decoding step, hash the previous K tokens to partition the vocabulary into green/red sets and bias sampling toward green; detection counts green tokens via a z-score
By inserting a hidden HTML comment
By modifying the prompt template
quiz.中文核对: 1是Kirchenbauer而非等同SynthID，Tournament另方法。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md
最终中文参考落点.heading: ## 30. 本次增量的练习与测验核对

quiz.question: What is the primary limitation of text watermarks against paraphrase?
options: Paraphrase only affects image watermarks
They actually survive paraphrase
Paraphrase strengthens the watermark
Rewording or paraphrasing the text destroys the green-token statistical signal
quiz.中文核对: 3过强：许多meaningfulrewrites降低signal，SynthID允许some mildparaphrase。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md

quiz.question: What does Stable Signature (Fernandez et al., ICCV 2023) do?
options: Adds a visible watermark in the corner of the image
Signs the metadata with a private key
Uses C2PA to sign the image at upload
Fine-tunes the latent diffusion decoder so every generated image carries a fixed embedded message detectable from the latent
quiz.中文核对: 3 decoderfinetune嵌message，但extractor从输出image不是必须latent。

最终中文参考落点.file: AI 算法基础/深度学习专题/13-负责任AI.md

quiz.question: What does the May 2024 'Stable Signature is Unstable' result demonstrate?
options: The watermark is provably unforgeable
The watermark requires C2PA to function
The watermark fails only on JPEG compression
Post-generation fine-tuning of the decoder can remove the watermark while preserving image quality, undermining adversarial robustness
quiz.中文核对: 3修改生成器使futuregeneration不带标，不叫已经生成图post-generationfinetune。

quiz.question: How are C2PA metadata and watermarking complementary?
options: C2PA replaces watermarks entirely
Metadata can be stripped but carries rich provenance chain; watermarks persist through transcoding but carry few bits; layered, they provide a usable provenance story
Watermarks are signed by the same keys as C2PA
They are interchangeable
quiz.中文核对: 1互补但robustness有条件，C2PAabsence不证可疑。

Because SynthID always produces false positives on human text
Because SynthID only watermarks generations from SynthID-enabled models; content from any model without SynthID is unwatermarked by default
Because SynthID only works on Gemini outputs
quiz.中文核对: 2无mark不证human/真实性，key/scope/falsepositive另核。
